head: Dustin Moskovitz gave $100M to Future Forward’s super PAC.
deck: This chapter goes back to earlier elections and widens to other donors in the network. Moskovitz co-founded Good Ventures, a foundation that funds AI safety work.
note: The bars show reported contributions before refunds, including gifts filed under his trust. Committees also spend money from their other donors.

head: 74% of the spending went against Republicans now in Congress.
deck: 24 committees took network money and spent for or against members serving on Nov. 26, 2026. The chart counts spending from all donors, starting at each committee’s first itemized network receipt on file.
note: The filings identify the committee that spent the money. They cannot trace an expenditure to a donor.
bridge: Which candidates faced opposition, and what did the committees report receiving?
source: Source · Federal Election Commission outside-spending filings

head: Outside committees spent against Thom Tillis years before Anthropic’s announcement.
deck: These two races show two routes for money into committees that spend against candidates.
note: The filings show where money went and when. They give no reason for the spending or link a gift to an expenditure.
